view: Oblique view Mari palace excavated mudbrick courtyard and low adjoining rooms, eroded walls with some surviving plaster, Syrian Euphrates plain beyond, no intact roofs or invented ziggurat, weathered archaeological remains.

eras.title: Courts beneath a mound
eras.caption: At Mari, excavation uncovered a large palace built mainly of mud brick. Its courts, rooms and archives revealed the organisation of a kingdom whose rulers depended on the Euphrates and the routes crossing its valley.
